spec.expr: sum by (platform, scraper, entity, api, reason) (rate(scrape_retry_total{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

spec.description: Retry scheduling by platform failure class.
spec.title: Retries

spec.description: Profile JSON hydration timeouts by low-cardinality page evidence. Shows whether Instagram returned a login wall, challenge, not-found page, or no known marker.
spec.title: Instagram creator JSON timeout evidence

spec.description: Latest HTML size captured when Instagram creator profile JSON did not hydrate. Large login-wall pages make blocks visible without logging full HTML.
spec.title: Instagram timeout HTML size
API calls by endpoint and outcome

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, platform, scraper, entity, outcome) (rate(scrape_duration_seconds_bucket{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[10m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, platform, scraper, entity, outcome) (rate(scrape_duration_seconds_bucket{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[10m])))

spec.description: scrape_duration_seconds: time of one scrape, not counting time spent waiting for rate-limiter tokens or in retry/penalty backoff. See Scrape wait time for the waits.
spec.title: Scrape duration (excl. rate-limit wait)

spec.description: Items waiting in the TikTok scrape queues (Redis). Creators: total queued and per follower-count tier. Videos: queued for scrape. Every creator worker publishes the same shared queue size, so values are max-ed across workers.
spec.title: TikTok creator and video queue size

spec.description: Largest observed ms_token age per proxy. A rising line near the configured TTL means refreshes are falling behind.
spec.title: ms_token age

spec.expr: sum by (platform, scraper, entity, state) (max by (platform, scraper, entity, state, worker_id) (scrape_queue_size{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))

spec.description: Live Redis queue depth by platform, scraper, entity, and state/tier.
spec.title: Queue depth

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, platform, script, api) (rate(rate_limit_sleep_seconds_bucket{platform=~"$platform",api=~"$api_bucket",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))
sum by (platform, scraper, status) (max by (platform, scraper, status, worker_id) (creator_scrape_state_size{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))

spec.description: Latest creator scrape-result states, separate from queue state.
spec.title: Creator scrape state

spec.expr: sum by (instance, platform, entity, mode, status) (rate(uploads_completed_total{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

spec.description: Bulk jobs POSTed by scrape_upload and not yet reconciled, per target. Capped per target by BULK_MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS.
spec.title: Bulk jobs in flight

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (max by (instance, platform, entity, worker_id) (files_pending_upload{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))

spec.description: Files on disk awaiting upload per instance, stacked so the top of the stack is the fleet-wide backlog.
spec.title: Upload backlog per instance (stacked)

spec.description: Bulk-upload records scrape.exchange already had. Should stay close to 0: a rise means the uploader's upload-state check (backlog server) misses videos that are already uploaded.
spec.title: Duplicate uploads

spec.description: Failed upload-state calls in scrape-upload. lookup: the backlog server could not say whether a video was uploaded, so it was uploaded anyway. mark: an accepted upload could not be recorded; the video stays "scraped". Should be 0.
spec.title: Upload-state errors (backlog server)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, platform, scraper, entity, outcome) (rate(scrape_wait_seconds_bucket{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[10m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, platform, scraper, entity, outcome) (rate(scrape_wait_seconds_bucket{platform=~"$platform",scraper=~"$scraper",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[10m])))

spec.description: scrape_wait_seconds: time one scrape spent waiting for rate-limiter tokens or sleeping in retry/penalty backoff. Duration plus wait is the wall-clock time of the scrape. High wait with flat duration means the rate limiter is the bottleneck; rising duration with low wait means the platform is answering slowly.
spec.title: Scrape wait time (rate-limit tokens + backoff)
